card.text: Earth-sized planet of TRAPPIST-1, one year every 9.21 days.

introduction.text: TRAPPIST-1f is 1.05 Earth radii across and 1.04 Earth masses. It circles its star every 9.21 days at 0.038 au, receiving 0.37 times the sunlight Earth does.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the measured radius, lit by its star. No image, colour or map of this planet exists.
